posts.author: juggle5
posts.content_md:
Hi

I dug up this Holodisk that I got back in the 1980's and want to build a nice

display for this classic hologram. Please see:

[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QMMr30XtYI0](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QMMr30XtYI0)

The Holodisk was a great technology that unfortunately disappeared.. I am 

looking for advice as to what would be the type of light to use to bring out 

the best in this hologram?

Thanks Ken

posts.author: BobH
posts.content_md: What you used to make the video looks pretty good to me! You might want to try an amber LED, but stay away from any that has more than a little dome over the element. All the collimating optics I've seen make the source much larger, resulting in bad smearing of the image.

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: That is just one of my favorite holograms.

posts.author: Anthion
posts.content_md:
I just asked the guy who made them all what he recommends for lighting. 

Use an MR16 or smaller halogen spot light from a couple meters away.

Have fun with the peaking. I always thought the bottoms of her feet seemed a little dirty.

posts.author: BobH
posts.content_md: He didn't make the ones I have. Probably made the image, probably made the transmission master, but I made the reflection intermaster and the contact copys I have while working for him.
